Improvement defined in advance (2026-10-09): 'beats the static baseline' is evaluated on the same baseline workload across SLO attainment, cost efficiency, constraint compliance and decision quality, with the pass threshold for each (and any tolerated regression) fixed before evaluation, so success can't be shown on whichever measure improved.
